title: narration.json (produced by human annotators in the viewer)

summary.description: One-paragraph description of the whole workflow goal.

annotations.description: Sorted by start_s, non-overlapping. Times are SECONDS (frame_events uses ms).

end_s.description: Must be > start_s; validated by the viewer/export gate.

action.description: What the user did, in one or two sentences.

details.description: Visible UI state, values, mistakes. May be empty.
